case_title: Ramesh Kumar @Babla v. State of Punjab
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under s.307 IPC, sentenced to rigorous imprisonment for 3 years
high_court_outcome: Confirmed the conviction under s.307 IPC
neutral_facts: The accused and other individuals were involved in a clash with another group, resulting in injuries on both sides. The accused was alleged to have used a sword to strike the victim on the head. The victim and his brother were assaulted, and the victim was taken to the hospital. The prosecution alleged that the accused caused grievous hurt, but the medical evidence indicated that the injuries could have been caused by a fall. The trial court convicted the accused under Section 307 IPC, but the High Court affirmed the conviction. The Supreme Court reviewed the evidence and converted the conviction to Section 324 IPC due to the uncertainty regarding the exact injury caused by the accused.
